description: Heat Network Locations (Existing and Planned) - Scotland is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The Scotland Heat Map provides the locations of existing and planned heat networks. Both communal and district heat networks are included. Data about each network includes, where available, heat capacity size category, network name, status (either ‘operational’ or ‘in development’) and the main technology used (for example, ‘boiler’). Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Energy efficiency, Energy resources, energy demand, energy supply, heat supply. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-02-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
